name: Dum Dum Park Bharat Chakra
description:
The concept for 2025 Durga Puja was amazing, it was based on unseen cosmic energy. Entire pandal was given a quite mysterious and dark feel, with spiral lighting. Even Maa's idol was more to merge with a calming energy.

Crowd Management was superb. Pandal was wheelchair friendly, and people were giving easier access to wheelchair.

name: Dum Dum Park Sarbojanin Durga Puja Samity
description:
Dum Dum Park Sarbojanin Durga Puja Samity 2025 truly left me spellbound this year! The theme, Prakriti’r Punorjibon (Rebirth of Nature), beautifully captured the harmony between humans and the environment.

The pandal was designed like a lush forest blooming back to life after devastation — with intricate bamboo work, natural textures, and soft ambient lighting that gave a serene vibe. The idol of Maa Durga looked divine, crafted with eco-friendly materials, symbolizing the power of nature and sustainability.

The detailing in every corner reflected immense creativity and thoughtfulness. The cultural performances, bhog distribution, and evening aarti added a traditional charm that balanced perfectly with the modern concept. The entire atmosphere was vibrant yet peaceful, drawing huge crowds who couldn’t stop admiring the artistry.

For me, Dum Dum Park Sarbojanin once again proved why it’s among the most anticipated and meaningful Durga Pujas in Kolkata every year.

name: Lake Town Park Sarbojonin Durga Puja
description: Months before the start of Durga puja, youth members of a community organize as a team, collect donations, engage priests and artisans, buy votive materials and help build a theme-based stage called pandal. The Durga statue is designed from clay and colors by the commissioned artisans. The design and decoration is a team effort involving artists, architects and community representatives hosting it. The budget required for such theme-based pujas is significantly higher than traditional pujas. These attract crowds of visitors.

name: Lake Town Adhibasi Brinda
description: Lake Town Adhibasi Brinda is one of the most vibrant community Durga Puja celebrations in North Kolkata. Every year, the pandal beautifully reflects creativity, tradition, and devotion, attracting visitors from nearby areas during the festive days. The idol of Maa Durga is crafted with elegance and grace, and the decorations often carry meaningful themes that add depth to the experience. Though it is not as grand as some of the bigger budget pujas in Kolkata, its warmth, cultural spirit, and well-organized arrangements make it truly special. The lighting, ambience, and local participation create a heartfelt festive atmosphere, making it a delightful stop during pandal hopping in Durga Puja.

name: Netaji Sporting Club Durga Puja
description:

name: Golaghata Sammelani Club
description:
For the first time, I had been there as it was on the way to Sreebhumi Pujo Committee. Their pujo and pandal was very really beautiful with a simple atmosphere. It was very much clean and well maintained. The interior was very too beautiful as it provided a soothing effect on my eyes. Their simplicity amidst the gorgeous interior attracted me very well. The idol was too beautiful. The beauty of the interior as well as the idol totally matched and lifted its gorgeousness to a higher extent.

The bus stoppage is Golaghata Bus Stop just before the Lake Town Sreebhumee Bus Stop. All the buses going to Airport will definitely drop you at the stoppage.

name: Udayan Sangha Club
description: Udyan Sangha Club is a vibrant community hub known for its strong cultural spirit, sports activities, and well-organized local events. The club actively engages residents through festivals, cultural programmes, and social initiatives that bring people together. Its playground and indoor facilities provide a great space for youth to practice sports and participate in competitions. The club is particularly appreciated for maintaining discipline, cleanliness, and a friendly atmosphere. During festive seasons, the decorations and events are a major attraction for visitors. Overall, Udyan Sangha Club plays an important role in community bonding and stands out as a proud landmark of the locality.

name: Aswininagar Bandhumahal Club, Baguiati
description:
Journey Through Bengali Heritage at Baguiati's Bandhu Mahal Club!
Baguiati Ashwininagar Bandhu Mahal Club has truly outdone itself with this year's Durga Puja theme, "Bangla O Bangali." The entire pandal is a fascinating journey that narrates the rich history and evolution of Bengali culture and its roots.
A standout feature is the magical, talking Adim Manush (primitive man), crafted from silicon, which brings the story to life with a unique storytelling element. The Durga idol and pandal setup are a beautiful fusion of heritage, history, and artistry.
This club has created a must-visit pandal that perfectly captures the essence of Bengali identity, making it a spectacular and memorable celebration in Baguiati.

name: Railpukur United club
description: Railpukur United Club in Baguiati is a well-known neighborhood club that plays an important role in bringing the local community together. The club is especially active during festive seasons, when it becomes a vibrant hub of cultural, social, and recreational activities. Durga Puja celebrations organized by the club are one of its main attractions, drawing large crowds from nearby areas for their thoughtful themes, well-planned pandals, and lively atmosphere.

name: Shastri Bagan Sporting Club
description:
One of the  most unique family idol of maa, where both Ganesh ji and Kartikeya ji were sitting in Maa's lap. Pandal was a bit small, but roof decoration was amazing.

Crowd management was quite good. They were allowing people in batches as place inside pandal was small.

This pandal was not wheelchair friendly

name: Arjunpur Amra Sabai Club
description:
I recently visited Arjunpur Amra Sabai Club during Durga Puja, and it was a truly vibrant and enjoyable experience for me. From the moment I entered, I was impressed by the beautiful decorations, colorful lights, and festive setup, which immediately created a joyful and celebratory atmosphere. The idol of Goddess Durga was exquisitely crafted, with intricate details that made the pandal feel both traditional and artistic.

The atmosphere was full of energy and excitement, with dhak beats, devotional chants, and people celebrating together. I enjoyed walking around, admiring the creative themes and decorations, and soaking in the community’s festive spirit. There were also food stalls nearby offering local treats, which made the visit even more fun and enjoyable.

Overall, visiting Arjunpur Amra Sabai Club Durga Puja gave me a strong sense of cultural connection and festive joy, making it one of the memorable Durga Puja experiences I’ve had in Kolkata.
